items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Little George Mitchell, yeah. We had him on trumpet.

ctx.x: the trumpeter? The little George Mitchell.
Little George Mitchell, yeah. We had him on trumpet. And we had a pretty good band. We
had a pretty good band. Mitchell had come from Louisville these years ago. Yes, he had. You didn't pick him up there, he was already in Chicago.
